create_dictionary_from_vocab_file: create a Dictionary by reading words and counts from a vocabulary file using read_vocab
index_text_data_with_dictionary: index sentences from a text file into word IDs using index_data with a Dictionary
limit_dictionary_vocabulary_size: limit the dictionary vocabulary to a maximum number of words using max_vocab
filter_words_by_min_count: filter out low-frequency words from the dictionary using min_count threshold
lookup_word_index_in_dictionary: lookup the index of a word in the dictionary using the index method
